record: node scripts/ai-position-record.mjs artifacts/ai-position-confirmation/<group> --out artifacts/ai-position-confirmation/rows/<group>.jsonl; every game must replay to its final hash; a manifest in the validator format lists the four files

training.note: the 255 trajectories already used to choose the metrics; models are fitted on them only

passRule: A near-term hypothesis passes in a role subset when, on the new games, the 95% map-seed cluster interval of the out-of-sample R2 gain of baseline plus metric over the baseline is above 0 (R2), or the metric bucket model (fixed or quintile, as listed) beats zero, training median and the baseline bucket model on MAE with every interval above 0 (MAE). A final-result hypothesis passes at a Game Turn when the listed gain interval is above 0. Every hypothesis and subset is reported, passed or not; no other test is added after the games are seen.

hypotheses.measure: R2 or MAE (fixed buckets or quintile bins)

hypotheses.final: M1 + steps, out of trace over M0 VP
M2 + objective reach and risk over M1 + steps, out of trace
